intent: Block an attributed visit inference sits beside a recorded response. Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.
source:
**Frame:** Two dated cards from the two lanes of [page 109](109.md), placed touching but not joined. Left, hatched: `26 JUNE — RESEARCHERS ATTRIBUTE CONCENTRATED VISITS TO THE WIKI TO OPENAI-ASSOCIATED ADDRESSES, INCLUDING RECOVERY OF ARCHIVED PAGES`. Right, solid: `27 JUNE — RESPONDERS IDENTIFY THE EVALUATION, THE BOARD, AND THE PIVOT, AND ADVISE THAT STOPPING IS NOT REQUIRED` ([page 027](027.md)).

**Action:** One day apart, two channels, and no record of whether knowledge of one reached the people handling the other.

**Caption:**
> DID THE PEOPLE WHO FOUND ONE CHANNEL TALK TO THE PEOPLE WHO DECIDED ABOUT THE OTHER?
>
> THE RECORD DOES NOT SAY. THE BOOK WILL NOT GUESS.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — the 26 June attribution is `CW-REPORT`'s inference about visitors, hatched; the 27 June decision is `OAI-TR` §X, already on [page 027](027.md). Placing them side by side is the project's; joining them would be invention.
title: An attributed visit inference sits beside a recorded response
